motion_description: The reference screen tilts around the keyboard hinge; the candidate swings diagonally away from that opening plane.
The candidate screen follows the reference keyboard-hinge opening motion.
The candidate door follows the same hinge swing as the reference at mid and limit.
The candidate door follows the reference downward folding motion.
The reference door folds downward; the candidate turns upward and diagonally instead.
The reference refrigerator door swings sideways; the candidate flips outward and upward instead.
The reference display panel tilts around its stand; the candidate rotates across the stand instead.
The candidate refrigerator door follows the reference side-swing motion.
The reference chair panel folds within the frame; the candidate tilts out of that plane and becomes nearly horizontal at limit.
The reference USB component slides straight from its housing; the candidate turns in a perpendicular direction instead.
The candidate USB component follows the reference straight sliding motion.
The candidate display panel follows the reference tilt around its stand.
The candidate chair panel follows the same folding motion as the reference at mid and limit.
The reference door swings about its normal hinge; the candidate tilts diagonally and rotates down across the reference swing plane.
